text_sanskrit: यथा प्रकाशयत्येकः कृत्स्नं लोकमिमं रविः । क्षेत्रं क्षेत्री तथा कृत्स्नं प्रकाशयति भारत ॥ १३-३४ ॥
itrans: yathA prakAshayatyekaH kR^itsna.n lokamimaM raviH . kShetra.n kShetrI tathA kR^itsnaM prakAshayati bhArata .. 13-34 ..
translation:
Just as the one sun illuminates all this world, so also the one Paramatma dwelling in Kshetra illuminates all Kshetra, O Bharata. (34) 
V. Kshetra: both the intelligent and the non-intelligent entities other than the Supreme Being. (34)
A. Sri Krishna concludes the topic of the chapter declaring also the fruit of the knowledge inculcated herein.
